game.title: Sid Meier's Civilization V
game.blurb: Turn-based strategy from Firaxis (RAWG also lists Aspyr Media), published by 2K Games and Aspyr, released 2010-09-21. RAWG average playtime: 27 hours. Genres: Strategy. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes (victories, leaders, civilization feats, empire building and scenarios), not a story.

chapters.title: Victories, Difficulty and Maps
chapters.summary: Each difficulty level from Settler to Deity, every map size and type, each victory type and ideology victory, a one-city win, a multiplayer win and the long-haul goals.

chapters.title: Winning With Each Leader
chapters.summary: Beating the game with each leader, and with every leader.

chapters.title: Civilization Feats
chapters.summary: One-off feats tied to a particular civilization, leader or unique unit.

chapters.title: Building an Empire
chapters.summary: Cities, Wonders, units, Social Policies, religion, spies, trade, archaeology, the World Congress, exploration and mods.

chapters.title: Scenarios: Mongols, New World, Ancient Wonders and More
chapters.summary: The Mongol, New World and Wonders of the Ancient World scenarios, and the scenario achievements that do not name their scenario (winning as island peoples, as Normandy, Denmark, Norway or Anglo-Saxon England, or as Korea, Japan, China or Manchu).

chapters.title: Gods & Kings and Brave New World Scenarios
chapters.summary: Into the Renaissance, Fall of Rome and Empires of the Smoky Skies, then Scramble for Africa and the Civil War scenario.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (civilization-v, id 13633). Steam app 8930 ("Sid Meier's Civilization® V") from the store list; its schema is named "ValveTestApp8930" (a placeholder name). None of the 286 Steam achievements is hidden. StrategyWiki has the guide at completion stage 1 but no walkthrough: Walkthrough is linked but not written. Written reference pages include Achievements (about 39,300 characters), Social Policies (about 36,500), Units (about 33,400), Wonders of the Ancient World (about 20,800), Wonders, Conquest of the New World, Terrain and Resources, Civilizations, Gameplay, 1066: Year of Viking Destiny and short pages for each base-game civilization; Buildings, City States, Combat, Controls, Difficulties, Diplomacy, Downloadable Content and the Paradise Found, Rise of the Mongols and Samurai Invasion of Korea scenario pages are linked but not written. So it was not recorded in sw-structure.json. The contents page also links pages under "Sid Meier's Civilization V: Gods & Kings" (including Fall of Rome, Into the Renaissance and "Empire of Smoky Skies") and "Sid Meier's Civilization V: Brave New World" (including American Civil War, Scramble for Africa and Conquest of the New World DX); the last chapter's name comes from those page names. The scenario achievements that do not name their scenario were grouped by their place in the Steam list; which scenario each belongs to was not checked. Three "Win on Emperor/Immortal/Deity" and "Win before 100 turns as any power" sit next to the Korea, Japan, China and Manchu wins in the Steam list and were put with the scenarios as a guess. Exploration goals such as finding Hawaii or Easter Island in a random map game, "Pillage 9 Farms" and the motte and bailey were left in the empire chapter. civilization.fandom.com redirects "Sid Meier's Civilization V" to "Civilization V", with about 205 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
